description:
Planet Search

This mod adds a search box in addition to the planet filter. That's all. It works as you'd expect.Why this isn't in the base game is something I'll never understand.

It's a utility mod and can be added or removed at any time.

Download: https://github.com/andylizi/starsector-planet-search/releases

Version v1.3.0 supports 0.98a
Version v1.2.2 supports 0.97a
Version v1.2.1 supports 0.96a
Version v1.2.0 supports 0.95.1a
Version v1.1.0 supports 0.9.1a

Changelog
v1.3.2 - Fix conflicts with some other mods; Be more selective when taking the blame for crashes
v1.3.1 - Fix the filter panel showing up when it shouldn't; Fix the search box disappearing when opening the Intel panel twice in a row
v1.3.0 - Major rewrite to support 0.98a. Make any crashes caused by PlanetSearch more clearly its fault.
v1.2.2 - Bump the game version to 0.97a. There are no code changes.
v1.2.1 - Drop support for versions below 0.96a; Relicense to MPL-2.0
v1.2.0 - Support localization via strings.json; Drop support for versions below 0.95.1a
v1.1.0 - Fix a crash related to map dragging; Add version checker support
v1.0.1 - Fix filter showing up on the planet info view
v1.0.0 - Initial release
